children: Cogent Biosciences said the FDA accepted its NDA for bezuclastinib in Advanced Systemic Mastocytosis and set a PDUFA date of June 29, 2027. FDA said no advisory committee is planned and no review issues identified at this time.
Regulatory acceptance de-risks the path to potential approval, a key value inflection for a biotech.
Sets a tradable catalyst timeline for a final approval decision.
Lowers perceived review risk and can be viewed as a positive signal.
Efficacy supports approvability; data underpins the NDA.
GIST (Nov 30, 2026) and NonAdvSM (Dec 30, 2026) add nearer-term catalysts.

This is a mid-to-late stage regulatory milestone following positive APEX data and adds to two ongoing NDA reviews. A favorable FDA decision on GIST or NonAdvSM first, followed by AdvSM approval and launch execution, would turn this into a larger revenue catalyst.
Based on the original press release from Cogent Biosciences, Inc. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
